title: The World's Root
text: A root of some impossible tree, as wide as a castle, curves out of the ground and back in. Sap like amber oozes from a wound in its side, and in the sap, caught like flies, are tiny figures. Some of them are still moving.

outcomes.text: Amber that never sets, and you try not to look at what is in it.

options.label: The strongest climbs into the wound.

outcomes.text: Inside it is warm, and alive, and gives them something.
Inside it is warm, and alive, and hungry.

options.label: Bind the wound with what cloth you have.

outcomes.text: The root shudders, and somewhere far off, a tree sighs.
